title: A Herbivorous Dragon of 5,000 Years Gets Unfairly Villainized
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A harmless, plant-eating dragon who has lived quietly for 5,000 years is mistaken for the evil dragon Revandia when a girl named Reiko offers herself as a sacrifice in exchange for protection from the demon king. The flightless, magic-less dragon and the stubborn girl set off on a comic fantasy adventure. Adapted from a light novel; MU lists the manga as discontinued after 5 volumes.
life_message: Appearances and reputations mislead, and gentleness can be a kind of strength.
